raw_production_reader_probe.note: This probe is diagnostic only; its count is not interchangeable with the canonical no-deprecated metric.

frozen_inventory_comparison.AAA-022-A01_inventory: 82 session-reader waiver calls in 44 package paths

proposed_waves.owner: AAA-022 integrator plus core/session and session-query owners
proposed_waves.scope: Reconcile the 79/54, 82/44, 87/57, and canonical 89-line inventories; classify each call as projection state, bounded historical window, complete-history operation, synchronous invariant, generated declaration, or test-only observation.
proposed_waves.precondition: Maintainer selects the canonical migration corpus and accepts the owner inventory without changing the frozen historical baseline.
proposed_waves.acceptance: A versioned inventory names every production call, rationale, owner, and retained exception; no code or lint rule is changed in W0.

proposed_waves.scope: Define the asynchronous bounded-history reader and durable projection seams, then migrate session-projection, session-log-deepseek, session-title, session-telemetry, and query consumers that do not require complete history.
proposed_waves.precondition: W0 classification; storage ordering, cancellation, inherited-prefix, and pre-commit invariant semantics are specified.
proposed_waves.acceptance: Focused Session, projection, restore, pagination, upload/suffix, and title tests preserve order, errors, cancellation, and model-visible reconstruction; remaining complete-history calls retain explicit reasons.

proposed_waves.owner: packages/core/agent-loop, packages/context, packages/interaction, packages/schedule, packages/goal, packages/todo, packages/plan, packages/workflow, packages/hooks, packages/sandbox, packages/feedback
proposed_waves.scope: Replace operational state reconstruction with maintained projections or current-event delivery; keep invariant readers only where synchronous append validation is a documented postcondition.
proposed_waves.precondition: W1 reader/projection contracts and per-domain state fields are current.
proposed_waves.acceptance: Each owner has success, restore, fork/inherited-prefix, cancellation, and teardown coverage; model-visible state has keyless snapshot or expected-output coverage.

proposed_waves.owner: packages/compaction, packages/subagent, packages/llm, packages/bundle, packages/skill, packages/api, packages/experimental
proposed_waves.scope: Migrate compaction windows, token accounting, subagent/fork history, API history endpoints, headless/skill consumers, and experimental team/review readers using explicit paged or inherited-prefix operations.
proposed_waves.precondition: W1 storage reader and W2 projection contracts are verified; complete-history consumers have a recorded reason.
proposed_waves.acceptance: Compaction, fork, API, and replay tests prove exact sequence boundaries, inherited offsets, cancellation, and output equivalence.

proposed_waves.scope: Regenerate API catalogs and paired documentation after public reader/projection changes, remove only stale waivers, and update TypeScript/Python projections when model-visible or Session behavior changes.
proposed_waves.precondition: W1-W3 package waves have focused PASS evidence.
proposed_waves.acceptance: Lint, typecheck, docs, generated truth, snapshots, and package consumer checks pass on the same successor candidate.

required_checks_per_wave: package-owner focused unit and lifecycle tests
restore/fork/inherited-prefix and cancellation coverage where applicable
keyless recorded-session or expected-output coverage for model-visible behavior
canonical audit-metrics ratchet and no new deprecated-reader waiver
typecheck, lint, documentation/generator gates, and git diff --check

authority.required: Approve W0 inventory semantics and the owner/order plan; separately authorize any new public asynchronous reader, persistence projection, pre-commit validation seam, or broad lint/compiler probe.
authority.not_authorized_by_current_record: The existing AAA-023 authority covers seven security/runtime/ownership/publication policies and the A27 six-owner candidate disposition; it does not authorize this Session-reader migration.

disposition: No production source, candidate, policy, public API, lint rule, compiler default, or released Session generation was changed. AAA-022:A03 must resolve the inventory and authority before an implementation-ready gate is created.
